how: The initial goose call identifies a starter who reports progress and receives design criticism and a proposed revision.
A member calls warriors to build a goose at specified coordinates.
A maintenance call questions whether anyone else is keeping the goose going, expressing concern without measuring available hands.
The starter reports progress and recruits in the same turn, so a separate start followed by a later call is not established.
The goose call receives design criticism and a reply about construction difficulty, supporting recruitment followed by reported building without measuring silent joiners.
The coded thanks concerns the subreddit prank, while the canvas help offer also requests a template, leaving bare canvas acceptance unestablished.
Calls and a conditional help offer do not establish the proposed preference for bare written joins or reveal silent pixel acceptance.
Participants revise the goose design, extend its neck, seek a signature, and propose familiar campus figures and lettering.
The starter and another participant report the outline and the interference that makes shaping it difficult.
Anchor coordinates and linked proposed pixel art make the mark findable and give contributors a design to work from.
Posting pixel art can invite further improvement rather than settle the design, so template circulation must be distinguished from agreement.
A suggested userscript and a bitmap request establish preparation for automation, while actual deployment remains unresolved.
Defence prompts a proposal to automate, but the record does not show the adoption needed to infer machine placement or its capacity advantage.

statement: Relaying backstage decisions into public coordination
how: Discord discussion returns an alternate plan and future instructions, while the Reddit master post promises continued updates from the stated headquarters.
The adapted coordination account needs plans relayed from backstage discussion to public instructions, even though the backstage decision process itself remains unseen.
One room cannot test the aggregate prevalence claim, and a headquarters with returned plans does not settle whether formal command was appointed.
Reports of spreading brown and encroachment recruit maintenance and defence that later become an explicit master-post priority.
The initial progress report is followed by a warning that spreading brown requires vigilant maintenance of the existing goose.
A defender attributes encroachment to a named neighbouring room, supporting attribution talk without independently verifying the placers.
Resistance motivates a proposed relocation of the head, but the coded passage does not establish that the move happened.
Concern about participation and a relocation proposal leave both completed movement and the specific insufficient-hands mechanism unresolved.
Requests for pixels, conditions on peace, and neckspace trades make negotiated boundaries an explicit local practice.
An outside participant carries a truce and relocation-help proposal into the host room on behalf of the competing logo effort.
Participants trade help for space and protection, while a neighbour later thanks the room for actual defensive help.
A defence call receives a proposed noninterference exchange, explicitly connecting a declared attack with bargaining over help.
Help offers can originate with a neighbour seeking the occupied site, so declared local shortage is not necessary for every exchange.
A treaty request is answered by a reciprocal defence offer, establishing help commitments through negotiation without proving every promised placement.
Mutual defence is explicitly offered, meeting the element's smallest alliance form without establishing a larger council.
Defence and an alliance proposal coexist, but neither a completed wider coalition nor common attack as its established cause is shown.
Participants invoke a truce and drop a replacement plan after negotiations to spare neighbouring figures.
A participant explicitly names completed negotiations as the reason a proposed replacement is dropped and neighbouring figures remain untouched.
A treaty grants another community a logo spot on the host mark in exchange for preserving continuous neckspace.
Demanding territory back contests the terms of peace, but does not establish a dispute over who may commit either room.
Negotiated deals and a demand for restitution do not reveal the predicted downstream dispute over representative authority.
Familiar campus figures and phrases become proposed lettering and images on the shared canvas.
A school target and a temporary subreddit swap do not establish that the specific antagonistic relationship predates the canvas.
The attack names a school rival, but the concepts do not establish the pre-canvas temporal premise required by this claim.
Participants can police which subjects belong in rival trash talk while still permitting jokes about the canvas mark.
The room performs and explains a temporary school-identity swap through copied styling, games, and comments.
Members perform the swapped identity through admissions, institutional systems, rankings, a library, and the other school's president.
Independent dating, service, and course jokes extend April Fools play beyond both the identity swap and the canvas.
Privacy moderation continues inside prank participation by removing an identifying game link while offering consent-based reinstatement or safer reposting.
Members dispute the worth of temporary pixel effort and complain about event traffic occupying the host subreddit.
A moderator removes a duplicate final-form post, showing a concrete limit on repeated event posting.
The complaint explicitly reacts to event traffic, but calls preceding duplicate removal do not prove recruitment caused the moderation rule.

statement: Attributing ordinary platform disruption to canvas traffic
how: A participant connects repeated Reddit glitches to event load, an unverified causal attribution that ordinary-sub-talk placement alone loses.
Participants celebrate the goose looking good, while nearby reports also mourn or reassess its condition.
The room shares a timelapse, claims cleanup, and circulates final-form records that receive admiration and checking.
Mourning and a later reassessment preserve different reported fates without establishing the artwork's objective state.
A report that the goose is going fine is followed by public celebration, supporting the local reporting-to-marking sequence without verifying pixels.
A timelapse precedes coded celebration and the final-form record precedes admiration, so recording need not originate in collective celebration.
After placement ends, participants challenge an earlier crest claim as unlikely to represent work actually built on the live server.
Keeping an event account can require checking whether a claimed accomplishment ever occurred live rather than merely choosing a preferred final image.
The room marks the end of placement with an explicit announcement that the event is over.
The ending announcement directs members back to studying, preserving an active stand-down instruction that successor-project language does not explain.
An instruction to study and a final-form record do not establish either a successor effort or a decision to abandon all event ties.
Final records exist, but no cited concept shows them producing a decision about what collective effort to carry forward.
Members call for erasing rival text, targeting rivals with local figures, and briefly converting a school sign.
The same speaker follows a call to keep the goose going with a reported attempt to cut off rival lettering.
Public dominance claims and comparisons carry the school contest in talk alongside attempted pixel attacks.
Attacks and taunts share targets, but the concepts do not establish that a particular attack produced the later rivalry talk.
Restraint includes a bare refusal of attention and an attack author's own retreat, so another member's reasoned refusal is not the only local form.
Replies to a replacement proposal invoke an existing truce and explicitly abandon the plan after border negotiations.
